'''Mazchna''' ({{IPAc-en|ˈ|m|æ|ʃ|n|ə}} {{respell|mash|ner}}) is the second-to-lowest level [[Slayer Master]], giving tasks to players with a [[Combat level]] of 20 and above. He is located in north-eastern [[Canifis]], and therefore completion of the [[Priest in Peril]] quest is required to access him. His tasks are relatively easy and ideal for players with lower combat levels.

He has a unique sword and is wearing [[Dharok's platebody]] as well as a pair of [[Dharok's platelegs]]. During [[While Guthix Sleeps]], he is replaced by [[Achtryn]].

Blocking a task with this slayer master costs 50 [[Slayer reward point|Slayer reward points]].

==Diaries==
Getting a Slayer task from Mazchna is a task in the [[Morytania Easy Diary]].

==Slayer points==
Players can receive [[Slayer reward point]]s for completing [[Slayer task]]s—this is based on how many tasks players have accomplished in a row. Completion of a task assigned by Mazchna will grant you:
{| class=wikitable style="text-align:center;"
!Task interval
!Points given
|-
|Every task
|6
|-
|Every 10th
|30
|-
|Every 50th
|90
|-
|Every 100th
|150
|-
|Every 250th
|210
|-
|Every 1,000th
|300
|}

==Tasks==
{{:Mazchna/Slayer assignments}}
Note: Mazchna is a valid contact for the [[Astral Contact]] spell, and you can obtain tasks from them.  It is part of the [[Lunar spellbook]].
